note: Small transient RV park beside the Mountain Valley (Skylark North) glider airport in the Tehachapi Mountains, its sites along the flight line; dry-camping and tent spaces too. A one-to-two-night stop between the Central Valley and the desert. --Claude
summary: Mountain Valley RV Park: operator posts $48/night with $3 off for Good Sam/AAA/military/AARP (cheapest $45); 27 W/E sites + dump, showers, laundry; online booking on Park With Us; 7-night maximum stay, so no long-stay concern; Google 4.4 (390). Under the $50 gate. Booking platform phone -> operator.
